objective: Al terminar explicas razones, resultados y contrastes con because, so, but, although y because of.

warmup.prompt_es: Dar una opinión es más convincente con una razón: 'porque…', 'así que…', 'pero…', 'aunque…'.

input.text: I like living in the city because there's always something to do. It's noisy, so I sometimes go to the countryside at the weekend. Although I love the countryside, I wouldn't live there because it's too quiet. My flat is small but cheap, and it's near my work. I often stay at home because of the weather, but I never feel bored.
input.es: Me gusta vivir en la ciudad porque siempre hay algo para hacer. Es ruidosa, así que a veces voy al campo el fin de semana. Aunque amo el campo, no viviría allí porque es demasiado tranquilo. Mi departamento es pequeño pero barato, y queda cerca de mi trabajo. Muchas veces me quedo en casa por el clima, pero nunca me aburro.

glossary.example: I like the city because there's always something to do.
It's noisy, so I go to the countryside.
Although I love it, I wouldn't live there.
I stay at home because of the weather.

md_es: | **because** + frase | razón | *I like the city **because** there's always something to do.* |
| **because of** + sustantivo | razón (con un sustantivo) | *I stay at home **because of** the weather.* |
| **so** + resultado | consecuencia | *It's noisy, **so** I go to the countryside.* |
| **although** + frase | contraste (aunque) | ***Although** I love it, I wouldn't live there.* |
- *because* responde a *why?*; *so* introduce el resultado. *I was tired, so I went to bed. = I went to bed because I was tired.*
- *Although* **nunca** se combina con *but*: *Although it was raining, we went out.* (no *Although it was raining, but we went out*).
- *because of* + sustantivo / pronombre: *because of the rain · because of him*.
**Puntuación:** coma antes de *so* y *but*; coma después de una cláusula con *although* al inicio.

common_mistakes_es.wrong: Although it was cold, but we went out.
common_mistakes_es.right: Although it was cold, we went out.
common_mistakes_es.note: No se usan juntos although y but.
